note_en: 不但……而且…… means "not only... but also," and the second half usually tops the first. When the first half is negative, Chinese simply puts 不 after 不但: 打印机不但不打印，而且开始发出“嗡嗡”的怪声 "not only did the printer not print, it started buzzing." Note that 不但 sits after the subject here, because both halves share the same subject (the printer).
